about_the_game:
In Void Wave Drift, you pilot customizable Ionblades—sleek anti-gravity racers forged for high-velocity combat across fractured tracks and alien skylines. Tear through the void using tactical powerups, unleash devastating attacks, and carve new paths by blasting shortcuts through destructible track segments.

Customize Your Ionblade: Change the look of your ship in the garage.

  • Drift the Void: Master gravity-defying tracks across exotic worlds, orbital cities, and unstable rift zones.

  • Powerups With Purpose: Deploy offensive and defensive gear mid-race—disrupt rivals or clear the path ahead.

  • Destructible Shortcuts: Unleash firepower to shatter parts of the track and unlock new shortcuts to win the race.

  • Game Modes: Conquer classic circuits, elimination sprints, and time and speed trials.

  • Sleek & Stylish: Pulse with a synth-fueled soundtrack and a razor-sharp visual identity inspired by sci-fi legends.

Precision. Destruction. Speed.

short_description: Customize your Ionblade and race through gravity-defying tracks in Void Wave Drift, a sleek anti-gravity combat racer. Use powerups, destroy the track to forge shortcuts, and master the Drift in a high-speed fight for glory across the galaxy.
